metrics.label: P/E
metrics.description: Price per share divided by earnings per share. Shows how much investors pay for $1 of profit.

metrics.label: EV/EBITDA
metrics.description: Enterprise Value divided by EBITDA. Measures valuation relative to operating cash earnings.

metrics.label: Price/Book
metrics.description: Price per share divided by book value per share. Compares market value to net assets.
